decision_policy: A deployment is listed when the issuer names the exact identifier on the exact network, or the official list of the bridge that mints it does (a network's canonical bridge, or a cross-chain deployment the issuer operates). Where the issuer names one contract on a network, a different bridged copy there is left out. GitHub sources are pinned to a commit; live pages were read on the date above.
